METHOD LIMIT, same as the research pass: every WebFetch was blocked by the egress proxy (Wikipedia, sports-reference, grokipedia, beyondhonolulu, NFL.com, ESPN, NBC/PFT, Bleacher Report, Colts.com, Hawaii News Now). All checks rest on WebSearch result summaries of the listed pages, not on verbatim reads. No primary-page read was possible, so the project's two-pass standard is met only at the level of independent search corroboration.

RESULT, AP ALL-PRO: all 57 research-pass entries were re-checked and none was changed. Corroborated from scratch: C Pouncey 1st and Kalil/Mangold tied 2nd; K Akers 1st and Janikowski 2nd (this settles the research-pass kicker conflict in favour of Akers); RB MJD/McCoy 1st and Foster/Rice 2nd; WR Fitzgerald/Cruz 2nd; DE Babin 2nd; CB Joseph/Rogers 2nd; KR Hester 2nd; T D. Brown/Staley 2nd; DT Atkins 2nd with Seymour/Wilfork; S Reed/E. Thomas 2nd; OLB Hali/Miller 2nd; ILB Cushing/Fletcher 2nd. Houston's 'Four Texans named second-team All-Pro' (Brown, Joseph, Cushing, Foster) is consistent with this. Items I did not re-check independently, and which still rest on the research pass: 1st-team G Nicks/Evans, T Peters/Thomas, P Lee, FB Leach, 2nd-team FB Kuhn, TE Graham, G Yanda/Mankins, P Lechler.

RESULT, PRO BOWL ORIGINALS: no original selectee was added, dropped or moved. Corroborated: NFC OLB Ware/Matthews/Briggs as original selectees; NFC C Kalil/Wells; NFC G Davin Joseph; AFC ILB Lewis/D. Johnson; AFC CB Bailey (with Revis). Brandon Marshall: a Miami season summary lists him with Jake Long among Dolphins Pro Bowlers, and he was game MVP. That supports him as an original AFC WR (item (d) of the research pass), though no source said 'original' in so many words. Paul Soliai also appears in that Dolphins list, but he was a replacement (see below).

CORRECTIONS AND ADDITIONS TO REPLACEMENTS:
(1) Research item (a) is RESOLVED. Roethlisberger did not withdraw: the game summary has him completing 6 of 11 for 181 yards and 2 TD for the AFC. No QB replaced him, and Tebow was not added. One search summary claimed 'Roethlisberger was replaced by Eli Manning', which is incoherent because Manning is NFC; it was rejected. Another said Schaub replaced Brady because Roethlisberger declined with a shoulder injury; that matches the January 2010 Pro Bowl (2009 season), not 2011, and was rejected.
(2) ADDED: Willis McGahee (DEN) replaced Arian Foster, 2012-01-17 (ESPN UK, Fox Sports and NFL.com 'Broncos RB McGahee, LT Clady join AFC's Pro Bowl roster'). The same articles corroborate Clady for Jake Long.
(3) ADDED: Paul Soliai (MIA) replaced Haloti Ngata (thigh), 2012-01-24 (Fox News 'Dolphins' Soliai added to AFC Pro Bowl roster'; The Phinsider 2012-01-24).
(4) ADDED: Brian Dawkins (DEN) replaced Troy Polamalu (neck) (NFL.com 'Dawkins receives ninth Pro Bowl berth, replacing Polamalu'; NFL.com 'Broncos' Dawkins added to AFC Pro Bowl roster'; NBC Sports Philadelphia).
(5) ADDED, SINGLE SOURCE: Ryan Mathews (SD) replaced Ray Rice. It rests on one search summary. Separately, a summary says Rice withdrew for family reasons. Re-verify.
(6) ADDED: Chad Greenway (MIN) replaced Lance Briggs (NFL.com 'Vikings' Greenway, Redskins' Fletcher headed to Honolulu'). CONFLICT NOTED: other summaries say Greenway replaced DeMarcus Ware. Those appear to describe the following season's game (ESPN story id 8833713; the CBS 'selected to 2nd Pro Bowl' story), which is later than 2011 and was not used. A summary claiming Clay Matthews was added in place of Briggs appears to come from a 2009-season Packers notebook and was rejected. Whether Ware and Ratliff played in January 2012 is unresolved: a Dallas Morning News headline of 2012-01-29 says 'Ware and Ratliff form Cowboys' smallest Pro Bowl contingent since 2002', which implies both attended.
(7) UPGRADED from single-source (R2) to corroborated: Fletcher for Urlacher, 2012-01-09 (Commanders.com; NFL.com). Roddy White for Calvin Johnson (sore Achilles), 2012-01-11 (NFL.com 'Falcons WR Roddy White added to NFC Pro Bowl team'). Michael Robinson for John Kuhn, about 2012-01-19 (ESPN 'Houston Texans' Chris Myers, Antonio Smith, Seattle Seahawks' Michael Robinson added to Pro Bowl'). Kam Chancellor for Dashon Goldson (Roanoke Times, 'chosen for Pro Bowl as injury replacement'). Chancellor's position label changed from SS to S because sources differ on SS/FS.
(8) CONFIRMED: Myers replaced Pouncey (ankle) and A. Smith replaced Carter (knee), per NFL.com 'Texans C Myers, DE Smith added to Pro Bowl roster'. Ryan Clark replaced Ed Reed, per NFL.com 'Ailing Reed latest Raven to pull out of 2012 Pro Bowl', 2012-01-25 (neck nerve, shoulder, ankle). Browner replaced Rogers; the sources differ on whether Rogers was injured or simply elected not to go, so the label is 'injury/withdrawal'. Atkins replaced Wilfork (Wikipedia/Geno Atkins summary; PFT 'Geno Atkins added to Pro Bowl roster'). Geno Atkins therefore appears twice by design: AP 2nd-team DT, and Pro Bowl replacement.
(9) Rejected as belonging to other seasons: Dalton for Rodgers (a later season) and Spencer for Matthews (a later season).

REPLACEMENT COUNT CONFLICT: AP copies say either 22 or 24 replacements plus 2 long snappers. Nine of the replacements were for Giants and Patriots players (Hawaii News Now / NFL.com AP summary): 7 Patriots Super Bowl replacements plus 2 Giants, with Carter handled separately as an injury. This list now holds 23 non-long-snapper replacements plus 2 long snappers (Condo, B. Jennings). STILL UNRESOLVED: (i) a summary says Terrell Suggs withdrew ('undisclosed'), but no replacement was found; (ii) any replacement for Ray Lewis, Revis, Ware or others, if they withdrew; (iii) Mathews rests on a single source.
